## Project context

This valuation is a personal research project built by Dimitri Prouvost, MSc Finance at HEC Lausanne (Asset & Risk Management), as a portfolio piece on biotech pipeline valuation.

## Author

- **Prouvost Dimitri**, MSc Finance, HEC Lausanne

## Disclaimer

This is a research exercise, not investment advice. All inputs are public. The valuation is an order of magnitude estimate, not a price target. Idorsia is used as a case study; no position is held or recommended.
